The flow node's booked, owner-ratified classification locates the presupposition in S1 — rung1's own declared-input scaffolding: 'background Lorentzian causal structure -> retarded/causal kernel K_R(omega,k)' buys retarded support only, and the collapse to one omega additionally requires t-t' dependence — WITHOUT invoking thermality, so the presupposition is not rung2-only. 'stationar' occurs zero times in S_IF.md (verified, grep count 0), satisfying CHARTER section 4's invisibility tell for omission-not-split. Under OMISSION_STANDARD conjunct 1 ('ESTABLISHED, STATED, AND USED — all three verbs'), the flow's absence blocks at minimum the USED verb: rung1's homed omega-analyticity condition and the entire downstream cone consume K_R(omega,k^2). The register's law prices what is banked and used, not what could have been written — the flow node's own sub_status: 'the claim is only that the framework HAS BEEN USING such a flow' — and the booked route that would defeat presence (the flow node's overturning clause: exhibit a formulation with no K_R(omega,k) anywhere, 'which would show the flow was never used') is unexercised. On the split-inheritance gap (the edge was wired pre-split to rung1_inin_action and inherited through 04dc7e1 with no recorded per-half re-test — verifier confirmed): true as history, but this adjudication IS the per-node re-test, and it comes out PRESENT for the formalism half — the split note carries the four priced prerequisites here 'because each is a prerequisite for WRITING S_IF at all,' and the flow is a prerequisite for writing S_IF in its banked fixed-(omega,k) form.

The R4 atomisation recorded in the flow node's tier_note tightens rather than loosens this: part (b) of the compound candidate (the STATE's invariance) is absorbed INTO rung2 as its own content, and a KMS state is invariant under a flow that must exist on the background for the definition to refer to anything — containing (b) makes the presupposition of (a) definitional.

representation_rung1.ruling: CORRECT (depends_on is the semantically correct encoding; the tier-contradiction rule's reading is the field's booked reading), with two consequential notes recorded
representation_rung1.justification: (1) With presence affirmed, R5's mandate as written requires exactly this edge in exactly this field: 'the nodes that PRESUPPOSE it MUST GAIN depends_on EDGES to it.' The relation R5 wires — presupposition, defined by conjunct 1 as discharge-blocking — is at least as strong as what the rule reads: the rule's text is 'a result cannot cleanly stand on an open/assumed input,' the module docstring defines the graph as 'the DAG of rests-on edges,' and a node whose content cannot be established/stated/used without X rests on X in the fullest sense the register has. The 'evidential support' framing the EDGE_INCORRECT case attacks is the advocate's gloss, not the rule's text. (2) The corpus contains ONE operative semantics for depends_on: resident.py reads the field uniformly across tier-contradiction, ORPHANED-RESULT ('a result should rest on something'), and BUILDS-ON-CLOSED; no booked text anywhere gives R5-wired edges a different reading; and the multiplicity computation R5's purpose clause demands IS the depends_on graph (dependency_graph builds from depends_on only; edge_note is machine-invisible free-form annotation). A purpose clause says why the wiring is mandatory, not what the field means. (3) Two owner-level texts contemporaneous with and subsequent to the wiring treat these edges as dependence-carriers with tier-relevant consequences: (a) the flow node's own ledger_note (owner ruling 2026-08-18, the wiring edit itself) justifies the +1 price because 'fan-out is carried by the dependency graph' — a rationale coherent only if the edges carry the input's epistemic reach to the dependent nodes; a tier-inert bookkeeping edge carries nothing, and the pricing argument would collapse; (b) the owner edge correction 2026-08-23 (rung7_w1_wz_map/u1_form_universality edge_note) adjudicated a 'tier-vs-edge tension' by content-dependence evidence with the operative dichotomy 'Tiers remain shown; the edges were wrong, not the tiers' — the owner's own adjudication frame contains edge-wrong and tier-wrong as the two options and no tier-inert third; if dependency edges were tier-inert bookkeeping that adjudication would have been unnecessary. (4) The register's typed alternative, edge_note, has a booked license: factual non-use (d5e9a99, applied as live bankgate law 2026-08-30, POST-R5-wiring: 'a shown result may not rest on a derived-pending input it does not actually use'). rung1's banked content uses the flow (presence ruling), so the non-use license is unavailable. (5) The rung1-specific counter-texts do not reach the edge: the laundering_ok machinery's booked scope is exactly the +delta LAUNDERING block (auditor.py LAUNDERABLE_TIERS/laundering_ok gate the delta>0 path; validate.py's WAIVED-BY-STANCE block enumerates laundering_ok with delta>0 only) — it is a ledger-arithmetic waiver over the four prose-priced inputs, whose own text enumerates four and predates the fifth; no tier-contradiction waiver instrument exists in the schema, and a waiver's availability in the F2 menu presupposes the rule applies (you waive a rule that applies). The resident rule-(3) comment ('legitimately-rootless... e.g. rung1') is scoped to the ORPHANED-RESULT rule and records the pre-omission fact of an empty depends_on; an author's expectation in a neighboring rule's comment is not an exemption from rule (2), and the fact it described was changed by an owner-ratified booking. CONSEQUENTIAL NOTES (costs on the record, not softenings): (i) rung1's stance_justification sentence 'the waiver says the ledger, not the tier, carries the inputs' is now stale as to the wired fifth input — under this ruling the tier DOES carry the wired input; the four prose-priced inputs' treatment stays P1B's; (ii) derived-pending's label fits a stance node imperfectly — the rule's phrase is a ceiling ('at most'), the landing is the rule's own, and the imperfect fit is a tier-ladder granularity gap for owner legislation, not a mis-encoding of the edge.
representation_rung1.strongest_counter: The booking-format-dependence argument, best stated in 9c14dfa's contemporaneous defense: rung1's four other inputs have the same logical status and sit as tier-inert ledger prose — 'if the Gaussian truncation were booked as its own assumed node, rung1 would flag identically' — so under this ruling tier consequence turns on booking format, not epistemic content. This is TRUE as a description of the live asymmetry, and it is the strongest thing on the other side of the whole adjudication. It fails to change the verdict for three reasons: it is an argument that the four prose inputs may be UNDER-represented (or that the convention needs an owner ruling), i.e., it is P1B's question verbatim, booked as a separate open pass and expressly fenced by the frozen protocol ('the edge-vs-prose asymmetry is P1B's subject, not a refutation of edge semantics'); its vehicle is builder advocacy self-labeled unsettled ('THE READING I'D DEFEND... Not mine to settle') in a message whose own operational framing contemplated tier movement as the resolution route ('resolving it means moving rung1's tier, which the owner reserved for its own pass'); and a real asymmetry booked elsewhere as its own open question cannot make a correctly-encoded edge incorrect.

representation_rung2.ruling: CORRECT, on the shared law at full strength plus rung2-specific grounds; no counter-text of any kind exists on the node
representation_rung2.justification: The shared chain from representation_rung1 applies with presence FORCED: R5's mandate requires the edge; the field has one booked semantics; the non-use license (edge_note per d5e9a99) is maximally unavailable — the node's own banked falsifier is inoperable without the flow. rung2-specific: (1) the node carries no laundering_ok, no stance_justification, ledger_delta -1 — none of rung1's waiver friction; its existing edge_note (the Ruling-B split-migration annotation) shows the node participates in the typed-annotation regime, and the flow edge was left in depends_on through the owner-ruled 04dc7e1 pass that simultaneously edited this very depends_on list (rung1_inin_action -> rung1_inin_formalism), proving the entry was touched, examined, and kept. (2) The only rung2-specific counter — the flow is the theorem's own stated antecedent, hence in-statement scope, hence the node's own conjunct rather than an external support — re-litigates the booked omission-vs-split classification, which was run IN FULL under CHARTER section 4's tell at booking and owner-ratified: S4's KMS mention is 'an ENTAILMENT of a named concept rather than an appearance of the candidate,' multiplicity (S1 presupposes the flow without thermality) certifies omission over split, and the R4 atomisation drew the exact line — part (b), state invariance, IS rung2's content and was ABSORBED into it; part (a), the background flow, is external to rung2 and booked at the flow node. What rung2 contains was absorbed into it; what it presupposes but does not contain was wired as depends_on. That is precisely the compound/omission repair discipline CHARTER section 4 demands, executed surgically. An external, genuine, discharge-blocking presupposition is what depends_on encodes. (3) The consequence composes with CHARTER section 1's vocabulary exactly: derived-pending = 'derived modulo a named open input' — the FDT lock is literature-verified GIVEN stationarity; the named open input is whether the declared background carries the flow; the flow node's discharge route (static-patch declaration, 'retires into that declaration at zero') reverses the demotion mechanically, which is the designed behavior of the tier, and the node returns to shown.
representation_rung2.strongest_counter: The conditional-theorem argument in its sharpest form: Callen-Welton/Kubo are shown as theorems independent of whether the declared background satisfies their hypothesis; a conditional theorem is shown AS a conditional, and its antecedent's tier is not a pending input to its own proof — so derived-pending mis-types a literature-verification tier. This fails on the banked record: rung2's claim is not the bare literature theorem but the theorem ENFORCED AS A HARD ADMISSION GATE on the framework's declared background (its own ledger_note computes T = T_dS = H/2pi on that background; its differentiator says equilibrium agreement IS the gate), and the gate's applicability to the declared background is exactly what the flow supplies. The register's vocabulary for a theorem standing modulo a named open applicability input is derived-pending, and the demotion reverses on discharge — the reversibility the counter treats as proof the input was never pending is in fact the tier's designed behavior per CHARTER section 1.
